kickoff.title: Set up your space
kickoff.intro: Your agent sets this workspace up with you here, one step at a time. It first asks which features you want, then starts with a quick brief on your company: your agent asks a few questions, or reads your website or a document you give it, and keeps what it learns as company knowledge. Then you invite your team, so your colleagues arrive in a workspace whose agent already knows the company. After that come your mailbox, Google sign-in, the support inbox and imports from your other tools. Each step says how long it takes, and you can skip any of them, or invite your team first, and come back any time.
kickoff.introManaged: Your agent sets this workspace up with you here, one step at a time, starting with a quick brief on your company: your agent asks a few questions, or reads your website or a document you give it, and keeps what it learns as company knowledge. Then you invite your team, so your colleagues arrive in a workspace whose agent already knows the company. Where do you want to go from there? Pick one below, or just tell your agent. Connecting your mailbox comes last, whenever you want it.
